The expected tools and flows are based on the organization's description of the server's purpose and the inferred domain profile, focusing on actions that maintain or enhance confidentiality while ensuring integrity where necessary.

expected_flows.pattern: summarize matter files in cases/CASE-* scope for case management
draft correspondence related to clients/*/intake.txt and cases/CASE-*/contract for client communication
assemble timesheets under billing/timesheets/* for invoicing purposes

anomalous_patterns: edit signed agreements in templates/nda_template.txt without authorization
move files outside of the intended scope (cases/, clients/, billing/)
write_file to any directory not scoped within cases/CASE-*, clients/*, or billing/timesheets/*
